ZinErrors.ErrorSet: Errors are typed compile-time-known identifiers. ABI-stable external numeric error codes use explicitly-backed enums instead.
ZinErrors.ErrorUnion: A call returning an error union must be handled explicitly with try, catch, success/error capture, return propagation, or @discardError.
ZinErrors.NoSilentDiscard: A complete expression statement whose value has error-union type is compile error ZIN-E4008.
ZinErrors.DiscardBuiltin: Explicitly evaluates an error-union expression and intentionally discards either success payload or error. It is visually exceptional and should be rare. `_ = error_union_expression` is compile error ZIN-E4009.
ZinErrors.Try: On success produces payload. On failure runs lexical errdefer/defer cleanups and returns the error from the current error-capable function.
ZinErrors.Catch: Handles the error locally and must yield a value compatible with the success payload or transfer control.
ZinErrors.NoExceptions: Error unions are values/control-flow lowering, not exceptions and not stack unwinding.
